research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Qumulo is researching tiered data storage with persistent and ephemeral layers to optimize file system performance, in-place erasure code transcoding for distributed file systems, bandwidth management in distributed file systems, error resistant write-ahead logs for verifiable file system activity, distributed resource caching, recovery checkpoints for distributed file systems, and backup services for distributed file systems in cloud computing environments. These areas reflect a focus on scalable, reliable file data management across multi-cloud platforms.

about_short_description.short_description: Qumulo provides a file data platform for multi-cloud environments with large scale file data.

product.name: Qumulo Cloud Data Platform
product.description: A distributed file and object data platform for managing unstructured data across data centers, edge locations, private environments, and public clouds.

product.name: Qumulo Cloud Data Fabric
product.description: A global data fabric that presents distributed file data through a consistent namespace across on-premises systems, edge locations, and multiple clouds.

product.name: Cloud Native Qumulo
product.description: A cloud-deployed file and object data service with elastic capacity and performance for enterprise workloads on AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

product.name: Qumulo Core
product.description: An on-premises deployment of Qumulo’s file data platform for data centers and private cloud environments using customer-selected hardware.

product.name: Qumulo Accelerators
product.description: Lightweight data engines for ingesting, caching, and accessing data in remote, edge, or resource-constrained environments.

product.name: Qumulo Nexus
product.description: An AI-assisted visibility and management experience for monitoring and understanding distributed enterprise data across locations.
